corpus.note: Rules derived on fit wins only. toward_fraction during expansion uses visible targets (usually none → blind). Folder labels are not outcomes.

choice_aggregates.note: MEASURED among inferred orthogonal neutral captures with >=2 neutral neighbour options. Orth capture is always Manhattan-1 from src, so 'nearest neutral' is not discriminative.

loss_skim.note: MEASURED skim only. Losses are held out of fit. Failure modes listed; thresholds not fit on this set.

candidate_rules.rule: Pure neutral expansion until first orthogonal contact
candidate_rules.support: MEASURED phase boundary == contact-1; contact median 82 on fit
MEASURED land curve on fit wins

candidate_rules.rule: Keep all owned tiles in exactly one connected component while expanding
candidate_rules.support: MEASURED components==1 in 341/341 fit games at expansion end

candidate_rules.rule: When >=2 neutral options exist, prefer the option that opens distance from own general and that is best toward the enemy general

threshold.units: fraction / capture counts among multi-option neutrals

candidate_rules.support: MEASURED choice aggregates; opens_ogen >> closes_ogen; closes_egen > opens_egen

candidate_rules.rule: In the 50 ticks after contact, continue grabbing neutrals more often than a hard contest pivot; mixed behavior is common

threshold.units: fraction of tile gains / fraction of games

candidate_rules.rule: During expansion, most inferred non-pass moves stay on own tiles (convey/consolidate); neutral captures are a minority of move events
candidate_rules.support: MEASURED inferred-move mix in expansion phase

cannot_determine: Pre-contact voluntary stop independent of contact
